targetText: The latter must not direct its daily activity toward the conquest of political power, but toward the betterment of the condition of the working class, within the existing order. It must not expect to institute socialism as a result of a political and social crisis, but should build socialism by means of the progressive extension of social control and the gradual application of the principle of co-operation.
explanation: Summarizing Bernstein's opportunist method: revisionism abandons the conquest of political power, proposing instead to manage capitalism through gradual legislative and cooperative reforms.
